title: Recording: With A Little Luck by Wings | 1977
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Wings finished recording the London Town song ‘With A Little Luck’ on 28 October 1977.

Paul McCartney added three keyboard and synthesizer parts, and double-tracked lead vocals. He and Linda McCartney and Denny Laine also added several tracks of backing vocals.
